---
title: About Me
---

Hi! I'm Palmer Maurer, a recent graduate of Georgetown University with a B.S. in math. I began my academic journey as a chemistry major on the pre-med track, but over time I developed a stronger passion for math and stats. That shift ultimately shaped both my academic interests and my professional goals, as I am currently pursuing a career in actuarial science.

I'm from Princeton, NJ, and I'm a very dedicated New York Yankees fan, hence this project's theme. I enjoy spending time with family and friends, and loved my family dog, Twix (a German shepherd and border collie mix). I also love golfing, listening to rock music (e.g., the *Eagles* and Springsteen), and playing the cello, which I've played for many years, most recently as the principal cellist of the Georgetown University Orchestra.

Travel is another passion of mine, and Italy holds a special place in my heart. I've been very fortunate to visit several times with my family, and exploring every region remains on my bucket list.
